task.title: Configure the site
task.shortdesc: Set the site properties from the approved baseline and validate the file.

taskbody.context: Copy values from the approved site baseline; do not invent them. See for what each property means.

step.cmd: Set each property to the baseline value.
step.info: A completed file looks like this: # site.properties (illustrative) ccs.site.id=SITE-SD-02 ccs.station.type=land ccs.platforms.enabled=mq4c,uuv ccs.datalink.mode=sim ccs.msg.gateway=msg-gw.site.local:7443 ccs.log.dir=/var/log/ccs ccs.ui.banner=<per site baseline>

step.stepresult: Output ends with Configuration valid (7 of 7 required properties set).
